reserves.issuerOrObligor: Hyperbeat, Midas, and allocated HyperEVM strategy protocols

reserveReview.rationale: At HyperEVM block 40439370, the active Depositor accepted USDT0 while the reviewed Hyperbeat documentation also listed USDe and USR as broader or legacy inputs. The sources do not pin a current 60.5% hoUSDT / 39.5% masterUSD allocation or publish a durable constituent split, so hbUSDT is represented as one dynamic strategy envelope rather than an unsupported static snapshot.

providers.name: Hyperbeat Insurance Contract and Redemption Contract

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Hyperbeat identifies on-chain insurance and redemption contracts and names Midas as the vault provider, but smart contracts are not legal custodians and the reviewed sources do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or current strategy-provider shares.
